subject: Validation artifacts for pen-test fixes and compensating controls
body:
From: Ravi Menon <ravi.menon@fintechco.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: security@fintechco.com
Date: Wed, 8 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request for validation artifacts for recent PT fixes

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the quick turnaround on the penetration test fixes we discussed last week. Our auditors have asked for concrete artefacts showing the fixes are in place and effective before we sign off. Specifically they want: screenshots of the updated auth flows/config, the remediation ticket(s) showing triage and verification, and any short notes about compensating controls where immediate code changes weren't possible.

Can you share those items (or a single shared folder) by EOD Friday? Also include the timeline for any remaining items and the owner for verification.

Thanks,
Ravi
Security Lead, FinTechCo

---
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Apr 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request for validation artifacts for recent PT fixes

Folks,

Forwarding Ravi's ask — FinTechCo needs a concise validation package with screenshots, tickets, and notes on compensating controls by Friday EOD. Monica, can you pull the verification evidence for the auth and session-hardening fixes (screenshots + any diff/patch summaries)? Evelyn, can you add the control statements (WAF rules, temporary ACLs, monitoring) and confirm owners/ticket IDs? I'll consolidate and send to Ravi.

Please include:
- High-res screenshots (annotated) of login/2FA flow and config pages
- Link(s) to the remediation Jira(s) with verification comments
- Short one-paragraph compensating control descriptions with effective dates and owners
- Any test run logs or curl examples showing the fix where applicable

Tag me on the Drive when uploaded.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Head of Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference

---
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Apr 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request for validation artifacts for recent PT fixes

Jordan / Evelyn,

I've gathered the remediation artifacts. Uploading to a shared Drive folder now (link below). Attachments in this email are: jira-FT-4287.pdf (remediation ticket export), pt-fix-checklist-20260409.xlsx (verification checklist), and a small diff summary.

Quick notes:
- FT-4287: Auth bypass vector patched in microservice auth-svc v2.1.4. QA verification comments (QA engineer Maya Srinivasan) included in the ticket and marked as "Verified" on 2026-04-08.
- Verification performed: unit test + integration smoke against staging (see checklist).
- Screenshots queued — will drop annotated images shortly.

Attachments: jira-FT-4287.pdf, pt-fix-checklist-20260409.xlsx

Monica Patel
Security Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference

---
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Apr 2026 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request for validation artifacts for recent PT fixes

Jordan, Monica,

I uploaded the annotated screenshots: screenshot-auth-config-20260409.png (login flow before/after + session config page). Also added a short compensating controls memo in the Drive (CompensatingControls_FinTechCo_20260409.txt) describing the temporary WAF rule we deployed and increased session monitoring we enabled while the patch rolled. Owners: 
- WAF rule: Priya N. (Infra) — rule active 2026-04-05 -> present
- Monitoring: Oncall rotation + alerting configured (runbook link in Drive)

One point to flag: we relied on the WAF rule for a short window during the rollout; the ticket documents the controlled window and rollback criteria.

Evelyn Hart
Security Operations Lead
Redwood Inference

---
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>
To: Ravi Menon <ravi.menon@fintechco.com>, security@fintechco.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for validation artifacts for recent PT fixes

Hi Ravi — thanks for the patience. Per your request, attached and linked below is the validation package for the items referenced in the penetration test report. Summary of contents and where to find them: 

Drive folder (view-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cDefFinTechCo-pt-evidence

Included artifacts (high-level):
- screenshot-auth-config-20260409.png (annotated before/after login + session settings) — shows the blocked vector and updated rate-limits
- jira-FT-4287.pdf — exported remediation ticket with verification comments and QA sign-off (status: Verified, 2026-04-08)
- pt-fix-checklist-20260409.xlsx — checklist of verification steps executed (unit/integration/smoke)
- CompensatingControls_FinTechCo_20260409.txt — brief rationale for temporary WAF rule and monitoring changes, with owners and effective dates

Compensating controls summary: 
- Temporary WAF rule (deployed 2026-04-05) blocked the exploitation pattern while patch was deployed; owner Priya N. (Infra).
- Enhanced session anomaly monitoring and an alert threshold (owner: Oncall rotation) to surface any unexpected auth attempts during rollout.
- Post-deploy rollback criteria and observability: ticket includes runbook steps and test cases.

If your auditors want a short signed attestation from our Security Engineering manager (Monica) confirming the verification steps, we can provide that by EOD Monday. Also happy to hop on a 30-minute call if they want to walk through the artifacts.

Attachments: screenshot-auth-config-20260409.png, jira-FT-4287.pdf, pt-fix-checklist-20260409.xlsx

Best,
Jordan Blake
Head of Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference
